{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric
df["sample_seq"] = pd.to_numeric(df["sample_seq"], errors='coerce')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prioritize highest sample_seq
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])

# Deduplicate: keep first (i.e., highest sample_seq) row per patient_id
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Verify deduplication worked: should be 848 - 48 = 800 unique patients
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Check that the response variable is binary
print(f'Unique values in responded: {df_dedup["responded"].unique()}')

# Check arm and severity distribution in the deduplicated data
print(f'Arm distribution after deduplication:\n{df_dedup["arm"].value_counts()}')
print(f'Severity distribution after deduplication:\n{df_dedup["severity"].value_counts()}')"}
